options.reason: The table is a feature matrix of 22 homogeneous MFCC measurements with three categorical outcome columns describing the same call at nested taxonomic levels (Family > Genus > Species), which is exactly the multilabel case in the rails; grouping by RecordID keeps segments of one recording together so MFCCs from the same audio do not leak across train/test. No column is a recoding of a target and RecordID repeats, so it is a group key rather than a row identifier.
options.title: multilabel
